value.description: The label value to match against

isRegex.description: Whether value is a regular expression. Defaults to false.

isEqual.description: Whether the matcher asserts equality (true) or inequality (false). Defaults to true.

matchers.description: Optional label matchers used to filter listed silences. Only used with 'list'.

operation.description: The operation to perform: 'list' to list silences, 'get' to retrieve a silence by id

rule_uid.description: Optional: filter listed silences to those scoped to this alert rule UID (matches the __alert_rule_uid__ label). Only used with 'list'.
